bio.text: Betty McCollum represents Minnesota's 4th District, including Saint Paul, all of Ramsey County and most of Washington County, in the U.S. House of Representatives; she was elected in 2000 and is Dean of the Minnesota congressional delegation.
She serves on the House Appropriations Committee, where she is the top Democrat on the Defense Subcommittee.

Before Congress she served in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 1993 to 2000 and on the North St. Paul City Council from 1987 to 1992, and her career included teaching high school social science and 25 years in retail sales and management.
She is a graduate of the College of St. Catherine, grew up in South St. Paul, and now lives in Saint Paul.
